description: This PHP file is part of the vtiger CRM project and manages the display of related lists in the Call module, specifically handling requests for related lists such as CallRelatedList. It includes logic for retrieving entity info, setting up Smarty templates, and managing related list sessions.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: A class representing CRM entities, used here to instantiate module-specific objects.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A class extending Smarty template engine tailored for vtiger CRM for rendering views.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Method of CRMEntity; retrieves entity information based on record ID and module.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to get an instance of CRMEntity for the given module.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related list data for the specified module and focus object.
